verdict.rationale: Lindy's Routines feature directly provides scheduled recurring automation. The docs say routines "turn your recurring work into hands-off automation" and that you can "set a schedule or trigger once" so Lindy runs the job on autopilot. The Daily Brief is a concrete example of a recurring scheduled job. Missing for 10: detail on schedule granularity and options (intervals, cron-style expressions, time zones), how to manage, pause or edit routines, run history and monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Lindy routines turn your recurring work into hands-off automation — set a schedule or trigger once, and Lindy runs the whole job for you on autopilot
Lindy can send you a daily brief on anything you prompt it to cover.
